scope: auth independent database R2DBC mfa_config migration gap

environment.databases: isolated random apex_mfa_ databases, PostgreSQL random matching roles; finally cleanup

implementation.version_selection: Scanned both tracked and untracked auth migration files; highest existing version V57; V58 absent before creation.
implementation.mapping: Twelve columns match com.apex.scaffold.auth.domain.model.MfaConfig, separate from MyBatis auth_mfa_config.
implementation.identity: MySQL AUTO_INCREMENT / PostgreSQL BIGSERIAL supports repository.save without an id.
implementation.uniqueness: (tenant_id,user_id,type); user_id index also serves existing user-only derived queries; unique index prefix serves tenant queries.
implementation.time_types: MySQL DATETIME; PostgreSQL TIMESTAMP, matching LocalDateTime.
implementation.ciphertext: Nullable TEXT secret and backup_codes follow existing EncryptionService string contract; no new IV or encryption scheme invented.
implementation.upgrade_policy: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS preserves compatible manually provisioned tables and existing opaque ciphertext. It deliberately does not normalize unknown existing table columns, identity configuration, indexes or constraints.
implementation.historical_system_unique_key: system historical UNIQUE(user_id,type) differs from new auth tenant-scoped key. Existing manual tables copied with that historical key require separately reviewed alignment; V58 does not remove that key.

meaningful_failures: MySQL: all 14 auth V44-V57 migrations succeeded, SELECT of twelve MfaConfig columns failed because mfa_config did not exist.
PostgreSQL: all 14 auth V44-V57 migrations succeeded, SELECT failed: relation mfa_config does not exist.
red.additional_errors: Two compatible-table fixtures reached direct rerun of not-yet-created V58 and failed CannotReadScript; these are not counted as missing-table proof.

coverage: Explicit auth filesystem migration location avoids system test dependency migration contamination.
Each vendor: full V44-V57 followed by V58, fifteen applied migrations, validate succeeds, no pending migrations, second migrate executes zero.
Each vendor: fresh database and compatible manually created table fixture with opaque test ciphertext preserved.
Each vendor: twelve columns readable, default status/failed attempts/created time, same user/type allowed in two tenants.
Each vendor: direct SQL script replay succeeds.
Each vendor: real R2dbcRepositoryFactory MfaConfigRepository generated-id insert, encrypted-string round trip, enum read/update, tenant-scoped derived queries, delete/readback.

limitations: No production auth database inspected or modified. Unknown manually provisioned incompatible tables are not repaired by CREATE IF NOT EXISTS.

PostgreSQL R2DBC driver available through apex-system test dependency; auth production POM lacks direct PostgreSQL R2DBC runtime driver. Tests prove SQL/mapping compatibility, not PostgreSQL production boot readiness.

Opaque test strings exercise persistence only; they are not real EncryptionService ciphertext or proof of cryptographic correctness.
Existing unscoped repository methods and overall tenant/security behavior were not changed or audited by this migration task.
